sources.title: When and Where Was the US Constitution Written?

passages.heading: When Was the US Constitution Written?
passages.text: The United States Constitution was written from May to September 1787. Since then, 27 amendments have been added to or changed in the Constitution.

passages.heading: A Perfect Union?
passages.text:
This careful balancing act between state and federal power makes a union founded upon a constitution carefully constructed.

The Constitution’s value cannot be overstated, but when and where did this vital writing process happen?

To answer, it’s important to understand the historical context that led to the writing of the Constitution.

passages.heading: Further Amendments to the United States Constitution
passages.text:
Beyond these 10, just seven other amendments have been ratified and become part of the United States Constitution. The most recent amendment was ratified in 1992, so you could say that the US Constitution was written between 1787 and 1992.

Thousands of amendments have been introduced, but getting them ratified is no easy task. It could be many decades before we see another change to the Constitution.
